questions.ask: You say "41 of the 60 are still paying" at "$8 a month". Walk me through the unit economics: what does it cost you to get one family, what do you keep from each $8 after the grocery side, and how many months does a family have to stay before you earn that cost back?
questions.quote: 60 families paying $8 a month since August. 41 of the 60 are still paying.

questions.ask: Tidy "orders the groceries" through stores you plug into one at a time, and the ask is to "add two more grocery stores". Grocery chains differ in every country. What does it take to add one store, and how would this work outside your first market without starting over each time?
